name: Epic Raven's Talons
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Raven's Talons

effects.name: Dexterity
effects.tooltip: Dexterity +9 : This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

effects.name: Bluff
effects.tooltip: Bluff +17 : Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Bluff skill.

effects.name: Seeker
effects.tooltip: Seeker +9 : Provides a +9 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +9 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

effects.name: Deception
effects.tooltip: Deception +7 : +7 Enhancement bonus to hit and +11 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

effects.name: Epic Raven's Eye
effects.tooltip: Epic Raven's Eye : 2 Pieces Equipped: +3 Artifact bonus to Attack and Damage +3 Artifact bonus to Critical Confirmation and Critical Damage +5 Artifact bonus to Search and Spot

flavor_text: Gloves like these make the wearer's attacks more precise and are often employed by drow scouts and spies.
